message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: Cache node modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.npm
            node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-

      - run: npm ci

      - run: npx prettier --check .

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: Cache node modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.npm
            node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-

      - run: npm ci

      - run: |
          npx vitest run
          npm run build
          npm run pack
          cd e2e/issue-189/v3 && npm ci && npm i ../../../zod-schema-faker.tgz && npm run test && cd -
          cd e2e/issue-189/v4 && npm ci && npm i ../../../zod-schema-faker.tgz && npm run test && cd -
          cd examples/v3 && npm ci && npm i ../../zod-schema-faker.tgz && npm run build && cd -
          cd examples/v4 && npm ci && npm i ../../zod-schema-faker.tgz && npm run build && cd -

  test-zod-v4-4-1-12:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: Cache node modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.npm
            node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-

      - run: npm ci

      - run: npm i --no-save zod@4.1.12

      - run: npx vitest run tests/v4

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    needs:
      - lint
      - test

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version-file: '.nvmrc'

      - name: Cache node modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.npm
            node_modules
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-node-

      - run: npm ci

      - run: npm run build

      - uses: JS-DevTools/npm-publish@v4.1.5
        id: publish
        if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          package: ./package.json
          access: public
          dry-run: false
          strategy: upgrade",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs `npm ci` in every job with no dependency cache, while package-lock.json exists (verified in repository files). This matches P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE: cache dependency downloads keyed on the lockfile before `npm ci`, preserving all existing steps, tests, and required checks. The measured node-modules experiment reported success parity with modest elapsed savings, and the cache step is added identically across lint, test, test-zod-v4-4-1-12, and build without changing any command, trigger, permission, or publish behavior.",
  "evidence_ids": ["P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-1ac2203839ed8c07-r2"]
}
